title: Cruciate
summary: CRUCIATE, verb transitive [Latin , to torture, a cross.] To torture; to torment; to afflict with extreme pain or distress; but he verb is seldom used. [See Excruciate.] CRUCIATE, adjective Tormented.

inlines.v: CRUCIATE, verb transitive [Latin , to torture, a cross.] To torture; to torment; to afflict with extreme pain or distress; but he verb is seldom used. [See Excruciate.] CRUCIATE, adjective Tormented. [Little used.]
